text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali and first lady Leila on Thursday evening received a group of citizens at the presidential palace of Carthage for a Ramadan meal.
- President chaired on Tuesday a cabinet meeting devoted to linking Tunisia to international computer networks.
- Four people killed and 52 injured in a road crash between a passengers bus and a truck on Raouad road, near Tunis.
- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui to leave for Madrid on Sunday for a visit during which he will hold talks with Spanish prime minister.
